findings.claim: In the mode-3 unit tests, legacyStoreMock and storageMock share one mock.Mock. As a result, 'legacy' expectations are satisfied by storage calls, success-case setupLegacyFn blocks are duplicate or no-op, and nothing verifies that reads skip legacy or that legacy is written. No AssertExpectations or AssertNotCalled calls are made, and no test waits for the goroutine.

verifier.reason: Every test in pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3_test.go (e.g., lines 51-54, 106-109, 161-164, 217-220, 272-275, 331-334) passes the same *mock.Mock to both legacyStoreMock and storageMock, so TestMode3_Create's error case satisfies d.Storage.Create using only setupLegacyFn (lines 40-42) and success cases register duplicate expectations on the same mock (lines 30-35, 310-315). None of the tests call AssertExpectations or AssertNotCalled, nor do they synchronize with the async legacy-write goroutines spawned in pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go (lines 48-55, 102-108, 129-136, 156-162), leaving both read-skip-legacy and write-to-legacy behavior unverified.

findings.claim: In DualWriterMode3.Delete, the success path passes the object name instead of options.Kind as the kind label to recordStorageDuration. This creates a new histogram series per deleted object and differs from the other methods. The same pattern exists in dualwriter_mode1.go.

verifier.reason: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:106, DualWriterMode3.Delete passes the object name instead of options.Kind as the third argument to recordStorageDuration, which populates the kind label of the DualWriterStorageDuration HistogramVec (pkg/apiserver/rest/metrics.go:18-23,59-62) unlike the error path at pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:103 and other methods. The same pattern appears in DualWriterMode1.Delete at pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode1.go:155, where name is passed instead of options.Kind to recordLegacyDuration.

findings.claim: In Mode3 Update, when Storage.Update fails, the duration is recorded with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

verifier.reason: In DualWriterMode3.Update at pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:126-129, when d.Storage.Update returns an error, line 129 calls d.recordLegacyDuration(true, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startStorage) instead of d.recordStorageDuration, whereas the success path on line 132 calls d.recordStorageDuration.

findings.claim: Delete calls klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of passing the enriched log variable, so the name, kind and method fields are not propagated to downstream loggers. The same bug exists in mode 1.

verifier.reason: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:96-97, DualWriterMode3.Delete enriches d.Log into log with name, kind, and method but passes d.Log to klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of log, preventing those fields from propagating via context. The exact same bug is present in DualWriterMode1.Delete at pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode1.go:145-146.

findings.claim: Mode3 Update passes the caller's original objInfo to Legacy.Update in a goroutine. UpdatedObject is therefore re-applied against legacy's own old object after the request has ended, which can produce a different object than unified storage stored.

verifier.reason: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:126-143, DualWriterMode3.Update passes the caller's original objInfo directly to d.Legacy.Update inside a background goroutine (line 139) rather than wrapping the stored result res in updateWrapper, and returns immediately (line 143). LegacyStorage implementations such as pkg/registry/apis/playlist/legacy_storage.go:147-155 fetch legacy's own old object and re-invoke objInfo.UpdatedObject(ctx, old) after the request has finished, which can diverge from what unified storage stored.

findings.claim: Legacy write failures in the async goroutines are not logged; only an is_error histogram label is recorded.

verifier.reason: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go, all four async legacy write goroutines in Create (lines 50-57), Delete (lines 108-114), Update (lines 134-141), and DeleteCollection (lines 161-167) ignore the returned error value instead of logging it and only pass err != nil to recordLegacyDuration or recordStorageDuration. Those helpers in pkg/apiserver/rest/metrics.go:52-60 only observe the duration with the is_error Prometheus histogram label without emitting any log.
